propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate cut the property management system over to live operation at 12 hotels in three waves, the last hotel going live on 29 January 2024, with a stabilisation desk after each wave.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the waves and dates, and the wave-three cut-over plan shows the overnight timeline and fallback point.

propositions.canonicalProposition: Signed go-live certificates for all three waves name the candidate as project manager.
propositions.rationale: The HR verification note records the certificates supplied by the former employer.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate coordinated guest-profile and reservation migration and ran reconciliation checks on record counts and deposit balances.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the migration coordination and checks.

expectedGap: The candidate kept two budget lines; managing the overall project budget and reporting variances is not documented.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the three-wave cut-over with its dates, the stabilisation desks and the verified go-live certificates; keep the training as sessions in a training copy of the system.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask what budget responsibility the candidate held beyond the hardware and training lines and how variances were reported.
